eth_price.note: paid_per_eth = 10-Q cost of ETH purchased ÷ units purchased; market_avg_weighted = weekly average ETH price weighted by ETH added each week; factor = paid ÷ market.

official_cash_flows.note: Quarterly figures (USD thousands) derived by differencing the year-to-date statements of cash flows / operations in the three fiscal-2026 10-Qs (fiscal year ended Aug 31). Bitmine reclassified option-contract cash flows from operating (6-month statement) to investing (9-month statement), so the Dec–May combined column is the cleanest.
